authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 5.2
authority.requirement: The section-map descriptor contains a Unicode section name followed by two zero bytes when the name length is nonzero.

physicalProducer.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, locally authored one-LINE DXF converted to AC1021
physicalProducer.observation: The AcDb:AppInfo descriptor reports 26 bytes for the 12-character name plus a UTF-16 NUL; other named descriptors follow the same framing.

finding: The AC1021 writer formerly used exactly twice the byte-string length and omitted the UTF-16 NUL from every named descriptor. The writer's internal section-map validator mirrored the omission, so self-validation did not identify it.
change: Append the two-byte terminator and include it in the descriptor byte length. Update validation to check that exact trailing terminator; the empty descriptor remains zero-length. The reader retains its preexisting tolerant handling for terminated and unterminated names.

validation.coverage: A generated AC1021 DWG is decoded from physical bytes through its Reed-Solomon system pages; each named descriptor must contain an even-length UTF-16 name with a trailing NUL, no early NUL, and in-bounds following page records. The same section-map test checks normal reader acceptance, malformed page-extent rejection and retry.

independentConverter.input: Locally authored minimal one-LINE AC1021 generated by scratch build with the terminator change
independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: Exit status zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input; no DXF was produced.
independentConverter.interpretation: The terminator is required by the source and independently witnessed; the isolated fix does not resolve the converter rejection.

limits: This test exercises locally generated framing and does not qualify arbitrary producer profiles or whole-file support.
